header: The Quarterly on press, plate to pallet
subheadline: Four issues a year, 4,200 copies each, printed twelve minutes from the Vienna office. These are the stages between a signed-off proof and the pallet that leaves for the mailing house on Thursday morning.

items.title: Plate check, 07:00
items.description: All 96 pages are compared against the signed proof before a single plate goes on the press.

items.title: First clean sheets
items.description: Colour is pulled to the reference print at 09:30, and two pages usually need a second pass before the run continues.

items.title: Binding and pallet
items.description: The full run of 4,200 copies is trimmed, bound and stacked by late afternoon, ready for the mailing house.
